mentions.name: WorkWay
mentions.description: This job board aggregates fresh tech and startup job listings that are scattered across individual company career pages and applicant tracking systems like Greenhouse and Ashby, bringing them into one place with direct links to the original postings.
mentions.problem: Jobs are scattered across individual company career pages and ATSs like Greenhouse and Ashby, making them hard to find in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on WorkWay. It's a job board solving the problem of jobs being scattered across individual company career pages and ATSs like Greenhouse and Ashby. It brings fresh tech and startup roles into one place, with direct links to the original postings and much more
